buyer_added_terms.text: 1. Generic OPTION CLAUSE 25% : The buyer can increase or decrease the contract quantity or contract duration up to 25 percent at the time of issue of the contract. However, once the contract is issued, the contract quantity or contract duration can only be increased up to 25 percent. Bidders are bound to accept the revised quantity or duration. For lumpsum-based service contracts, the buyer may increase the scope of work and contract value up to 25 percent with the consent of the service provider 2. Buyer Added Bid Specific SLA Text Clause(s) 1. Applicability: - (a) Indian Railways’ (IR) General Conditions of Contract 2018 (GCC) for Services will be applicable to this c ontract. IR GCC for Services 2018 is readily available at https://indianrailways.gov.in/railwayboard/uploads/ directorate/Transformation_Cell/Circulars/GCCS_R.pdf (b) Minimum eligibility criteria as per para 2.6.1.1 and 2.6.1.2 of IR GCC for Services 2018 will be appli cable for Technical bid evaluation. Similar service contract for evaluation purpose is defined as, “The w ork of housekeeping / cleaning / horticulture / office management / catering / maintenance and / or operation of any installation / maintenance activity i nvolving supply of contract labour for any Central / State Government depa rtment / PSU.”

(c) Two packet bid system shall be applicable to this tender. The bidder shall submit along with the Bid doc ument, documents in support of their claim to fulfil the minimum eligibility criteria as mentioned in the bid. Each documents/ certificates in support of credentials, submitted by the bidder, shall be self-attested by t he bidder or authorized representative of the bidding firm. Self-attestation shall include signature, stamp a nd date on each page if hard copy is scanned or a digital signature per document/ certificate. (d) The bidder shall mandatorily submit an AFFIDAVIT FOR CREDENTIALS (copy enclosed) to the effect that all the documents submitted by his/her along with his/her bid are true. The bid shall be summarily rejected if the bidder fails to submit this undertaking along with the bid. (e) Para 2.6.1.3 of IR GCC will also be applicable which stipulates defining of Other Criteria as per Annexur e –I of GCC for Services 2018 wherein each bidder shall be assigned score for their technical bid. The score of technical bid should be more than or equal to minimum qualifying marks for the bidders, which has bee n fixed at 50% for this tender. All those bidders who do not attain the qualifying marks shall not be consid ered for opening their financial bids. (f) In case the evaluated financial offers of two or more technically qualified bidders are lowest and same, bids will be evaluated as per GeM. (g) Variations in Quantities- During Execution of Contract will be governed as per provisions contained in P ara 5.3.4 of IR GCC. (h) if tenderer submit EMD/Bid security in OFFLINE MODE, Original Copy of Demand draft/Banker’s Cheque or in other mode as per GCC, shall be submitted to this office before opening of bids. 2. The bidders shall be required to submit an undertaking certifying the truthfulness of all the documents s ubmitted/uploaded along with the tender. This shall be mandatory for all the bidders. In case of failure of th e bidder to submit the undertaking, their offer shall be summarily rejected. 3. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer uploaded ATC document Click here to view the file. 4.
